diagnosis_summary.ram_failure_explanation: The saved reentrancy pointer at 0x2000FD84 changed from 0x20000124 to 0x20000024 (bit 8 lost). Direct J-Link patterns reproduced bit-8 read/write mismatch at four upper-SRAM words. Moving initial MSP lower by 4KB still failed; moving it to 0x20007FF0 reached the main loop. This establishes an upper-SRAM access anomaly on this chip/board, not its manufacturing/electrical root cause.
